title: L1 ticket triage sweep
summary: Sweeps your open, unassigned Zendesk tickets, classifies each one and drafts a first reply as an internal note for an agent to review.
trigger: Manual run; schedule it every hour or at the start of each shift
setup: Import the template and connect Zendesk.
Run it. It reads your most recent new and open tickets that have no assignee.
Each ticket gets one internal note with category, priority, sentiment, suggested group and a draft reply. Customers never see these notes.
Set `max_tickets` (default 20) to process more or fewer per run, and `dry_run` to preview without writing notes.
Edit the `l1-triage-agent` agent to match your categories, groups and tone.
notes: Writes an internal note and adds the `l1_triaged` tag. It does not change status, priority, assignee or other tags, and never sends a public reply.
Tickets tagged `l1_triaged` are skipped, so re-running is safe. Remove the tag to triage a ticket again.
Checks the 100 most recently created tickets per run. For triage on every new ticket as it arrives, use the webhook-based Zendesk Ticket Triage template.
